cases.translation: When they had completely eaten the earth.
cases.explain: The transitive verb объели (ate) governs the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.translation: This is what the Lord showed me.
cases.explain: Господь is the grammatical subject of the verb показал (showed), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: God's voice resounded from the sky.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я встану с мечом против дома ___.
cases.translation: I will rise with a sword against the house of Jeroboam.
cases.explain: The preposition против (against) with the meaning of opposition governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: I place a plumb line in the midst of my people.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (in the midst of, among) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The sanctuaries in the heights of Isaac will be laid waste.
cases.explain: The noun phrase possessive construction uses the genitive case: 'the heights of Isaac.'

cases.sentence: Земля не в силах терпеть всех слов ___.
cases.translation: The land cannot bear all his words.
cases.explain: The genitive pronoun его functions as a possessive: 'his words.'

cases.translation: Do not prophesy anymore in Bethel.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the meaning of location in proper names governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Вот что владыка Господь показал мне.
reading.question: What did the Lord Yahweh show to Amos?
reading.explain: The text states that the Lord showed Amos visions of judgment, beginning with locusts, fire, and a plumb line.

reading.ru: Когда они дочисто объели землю, я вскричал.
reading.question: What did Amos do when the locusts had eaten the earth?
reading.explain: The text says: 'When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said [cried out].'

reading.question: Why did Amos plead for mercy for Jacob?
options: Jacob was very small and fragile
reading.correct: Jacob was very small and fragile
reading.explain: Amos pleaded because Jacob is small (мал) and would not be able to survive the judgments.

reading.ru: Я кладу отвес среди моего народа, Израиля.
reading.question: What did the Lord say He would place in the midst of Israel?
reading.explain: The text states: 'I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel.'

reading.ru: Я был пастухом и ухаживал за тутовыми деревьями.
reading.question: What was Amos's occupation before becoming a prophet?
options: He was a farmer of sycamore figs
reading.correct: He was a farmer of sycamore figs
reading.explain: Amos said: 'I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs.'

reading.ru: Поэтому вот что говорит Господь: Городской блудницей станет твоя жена.
reading.question: What did the Lord say would happen to Amaziah's wife?
options: She would become a prostitute in the city
She would escape to another land
reading.correct: She would become a prostitute in the city
reading.explain: The Lord pronounced judgment: 'Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city.'
